maya: quick sync — I'm drafting a deployment-aware checklist for calibration dataset selection + prompt curation for quant bakeoffs (FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ). need rules that tie sampling to real deployment profiles. thoughts?
cheng: available. do you want separate pools per profile (low-latency, balanced, cost-optimized) or one mega-pool with profile tags?
maya: prefer tagged mega-pool but enforce profile-weighted stratified draws so comparisons are apples-to-apples. include negative controls and adversarial edgecases.
liam: practical sampling proposal: maintain strata = [chat_short, chat_long, completions, code, rag_qa, embeds]. sample weights mirror traffic but allow override per bakeoff: e.g., int8 bakeoff => upweight code & rag.
audrey: +1. also require an "anchor" set per strata: 200 high-signal prompts that are frozen across runs so we track regression drift. anchors must be curated and have human-verified references.
maya: agree. anchors immutable. also require metadata: source, traffic_fraction, difficulty, tags, anchor_bool, dataset_hash, sampling_commit.
sam: putting an example command for reproducible sampling: 
```
# sample stratified pool, produce anchors and holdouts
python tools/sample_pool.py \ 
  --input data/all_prompts.jsonl \ 
  --strata chat_short,chat_long,completions,code,rag,embeds \ 
  --weights 0.40,0.20,0.15,0.10,0.10,0.05 \ 
  --anchors-per-strata 200 \ 
  --holdout 0.10 \ 
  --seed 2026 \ 
  --out samples/bakeoff-2026-03-18.jsonl
```
cheng: metric checklist per stratum: chat -> avg token perplexity delta, human fluency score; code -> pass@k, unit-test accuracy; rag_qa -> exact match / F1; embeds -> cosine drop / recall@k. always report median and 95p deltas for each metric.
liam: also log model config + quant backend mapping: e.g., AWQ-int8, GPTQ-1pass, FP8-auto. map these to deployment profiles: 
- low-latency: prefer FP8 or FP8+KV-cache tuned kernels (SLO p50 <= target)
- balanced: FP8 or GPTQ depending on accuracy delta
- cost-optimized: INT8/GPTQ/AWQ aggressive quant with rollback thresholds
audrey: Add human slice quotas: 1% random review or min 500 samples per bakeoff, plus focused slices on hallucination/code-incorrect/safety. human labels stored as separate artifact with rater ids redacted.
maya: important: include paraphrase/semantic-preserving transforms as negative-controls to detect calibration drift. e.g., paraphrase the prompt but keep reference answer.
cheng: evaluation cadence suggestion: nightly quick-check (1k samples spanning strata, smoke metrics); weekly full bakeoff (20k samples, anchors + holdout); monthly regression run (traffic replay using last 7 days).
sam: CI artifact should include: sampling script commit SHA, random seed, dataset hash, list of prompt IDs, release tag for models, and generation configs (temp, top_p, batch_size). example JSON snippet stored with artifacts.
eval-bot: Triggered: bakeoff job started -> rdx-7b-awq-int8 vs rdx-7b-fp8 baseline. job_id: bakeoff-1749954321-01
liam: for reporting, compute both absolute and relative deltas. require flags: regressions flagged when median metric delta > threshold OR 95p > larger threshold. keep conservative thresholds for safety-sensitive slices.
audrey: also require per-token latency profiles (p50/p95/p99) and memory footprint per model variant. deployment teams need those when mapping to Dedicated or Private.
maya: need an explicit fallback decision tree in bakeoff README. if accuracy delta within X and latency within SLO -> promote. else if accuracy fails but latency is good -> consider mixed routing/fallback to FP8 baseline for critical routes. document automatic fallback rules.
cheng: small operational note: store full generation outputs (both tokens and final strings) for anchors and flagged samples for easier triage.
liam: one more — ensure prompt metadata schema: {id, text, stratum, anchor_bool, source, difficulty, traffic_pct, sampling_seed, tags}. export as JSONL.
audrey: add: require at least 3 temperature settings (0.0, 0.7, 1.2) to catch degenerate sampling behaviors; include a deterministic zero-temp run for code/regression checks.
maya: perfect. I'll turn this into a compact checklist and publish to the eng-ml docs. ping me when sample pack is pushed. :thumbsup: 
cheng: pushing initial sample pack to `s3://redwood-ml-bakeoffs/bakeoff-1749954321/` in ~30m. :eyes: 
liam: will add monitoring dashboards mapping metrics <-> deployment profiles.
audrey: and I'll arrange human eval scheduling.
maya: thanks all. follow-up: include concrete thresholds in checklist before next bakeoff.
_note: Slack thread representing a short planning conversation about calibration dataset selection and prompt curation for quantization bakeoffs. messages are chronological and intentionally terse to match Slack style.
